name: agentic-sdlc
description: Gated SDLC skills for spec, plan, TDD, security review, and evidence-backed delivery on Kimi Code CLI.
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code adapter for AGENTIC-SDLC:
- Activate skills with the available skill mechanism or read their installed SKILL.md.
- Map TaskCreate/TaskUpdate/TodoWrite to TodoList when the session exposes it.
- Dispatch Agent using a discovered custom plugin role when available; otherwise use coder, explore or plan and pass the bundled role instructions. Do not invent general-purpose or assume nested Agent is available.
- No Claude Workflow runtime is available: use Agent author -> critic -> revise with saved artifacts and validate_artifacts.py, or explicitly mark the degraded inline pass.
- Resolve runtime-root/CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/PLUGIN_ROOT notation from the loaded skill path: remove skills/<name>/SKILL.md to locate the installed plugin root. KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT is documented for hook processes; do not assume a Bash environment alias.
- Use actual Kimi tool names; FetchURL replaces WebFetch. A shared role tools allowlist may omit FetchURL, so use an available profile with the required tools and pass the role instructions when needed.

interface.shortDescription: Gated spec, plan, TDD, security, and review workflows
interface.longDescription: AGENTIC-SDLC packages gated spec, plan, TDD, security review, and evidence-backed delivery procedure as skills, a manual git-safety-check command, and deterministic PreToolUse guard hooks for Kimi Code CLI.
